title: Among posts edited by either 'Yevgeny' or 'Harvey Motulsky' and created in
question: Among posts edited by either 'Yevgeny' or 'Harvey Motulsky' and created in 2010, what percentage have a score above 50? Return the editor's display name, total number of such posts, number of high-score posts (Score > 50), and the computed percentage.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    u.XCL_055 AS editor_display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS total_posts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN p.XCL_026 END) AS high_score_posts,
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.XCL_031 > 50 THEN p.XCL_026 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM postHistory ph
JOIN posts p ON ph.XCL_014 = p.XCL_026
JOIN users u ON ph.XCL_017 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_055 IN ('Yevgeny', 'Harvey Motulsky')
  AND strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
GROUP BY u.XCL_055
